att_title: Attestation - the commander's periodic assessment of an officer
att_loyal: Devoted to the cause of the Party of Lenin and Stalin and to the socialist Motherland.
att_skill_0: His flying is weak; he needs further training.
att_skill_1: He has mastered piloting satisfactorily but must keep working at it.
att_skill_2: He has mastered piloting and the combat use of his aircraft well.
att_skill_3: He has mastered his aircraft excellently and flies competently and with confidence.
att_courage_0: In air combat he acts hesitantly.
att_courage_1: In air combat he acts cautiously.
att_courage_2: In air combat he acts boldly and on his own initiative.
att_courage_3: In air combat he shows courage, boldness and determination.
att_discipline_1: Disciplined, with occasional remarks against him.
att_discipline_3: Disciplined, demanding of himself and of his subordinates.

att_keep: Conclusion: fit for his present post.
att_senior: Conclusion of the senior commanders: agree with the attestation's conclusion.
